name: Open WebUI
description: Open WebUI channels integration via REST API and Socket.IO.

open-webui.label: Open WebUI
open-webui.description: Open WebUI channels integration via REST API and Socket.IO.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Open WebUI instance.

email.description: Email address for the dedicated Open WebUI bot user.

password.description: Password for the dedicated Open WebUI bot user.

userId.description: Optional Open WebUI user id for the bot account.

channelIds.description: Open WebUI channel ids to monitor. Empty means all channels.

requireMention.description: Require an explicit bot mention in non-DM chats.

name.description: Optional display name for this Open WebUI account.

textChunkLimit.description: Maximum text length per outbound Open WebUI message.

progressEvents.description: Mirror OpenClaw Control UI agent events back to the originating Open WebUI channel as JSON messages.

enabled.description: Enable mirroring of OpenClaw agent events for Open WebUI-originated runs.

includeStreams.description: Optional allow-list of OpenClaw agent event streams to mirror. Defaults to all public Control UI streams except thinking.

excludeStreams.description: Optional deny-list of OpenClaw agent event streams to suppress.

includeThinking.description: Also mirror thinking events when the runtime exposes them. Disabled by default to avoid exposing internal reasoning.

maxMessageChars.description: Optional maximum serialized JSON characters per mirrored event before truncation.

codeFence.description: Wrap mirrored JSON events in a Markdown json code fence.
